elements.requirement: References in section 72 of the Finance Act 2007 to a provision of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 are to the provision as it had effect prior to variation by the Stamp Duty Land Tax (Variation of the Finance Act 2003) Regulations 2006.

elements.requirement: In Step Two of paragraph 12(1) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, paragraph (b) is amended to require that the person connected with the relevant owner must be an individual.
elements.quote: for “or is connected with the relevant owner” substitute “ or is an individual connected with the relevant owner ”

elements.requirement: In Step Two of paragraph 12(1) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, if there is no relevant owner who has a corresponding partner, the sum of the lower proportions is nil.
elements.quote: If there is no relevant owner with a corresponding partner, the sum of the lower proportions is nil.

elements.requirement: For the purpose of paragraph (b) of Step 2 in paragraph 12 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, a company is treated as an individual connected with the relevant owner in so far as it holds property as trustee and is connected with the relevant owner solely by reason of section 839(3) of the Taxes Act 1988.
elements.quote: a company is to be treated as an individual connected with the relevant owner in so far as it— aholds property as trustee, andbis connected with the relevant owner only because of section 839(3) of the Taxes Act 1988

elements.requirement: Paragraph 13 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, concerning transfers to a partnership where all partners are companies, is omitted.
elements.quote: Omit paragraph 13 (transfer to partnership where all partners are companies).

elements.requirement: Sub-paragraphs (1)(b) and (4) of paragraph 14 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 are omitted, and the words 'for consideration' are omitted from the italic cross-heading before it.
elements.quote: omit sub-paragraphs (1)(b) and (4), and

elements.requirement: An interest in respect of the transfer of which paragraph 14 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 applies is treated as a chargeable interest for the purposes of paragraph 3(1) of Schedule 7 to the Finance Act 2003 to the extent that the relevant partnership property consists of a chargeable interest.
elements.quote: An interest in respect of the transfer of which this paragraph applies shall be treated as a chargeable interest for the purposes of paragraph 3(1) of Schedule 7 to the extent that the relevant partnership property consists of a chargeable interest.

elements.requirement: In Step Two of paragraph 20(1) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, paragraph (b) is amended to require that the person connected with the relevant owner must have been an individual.
elements.quote: for “or was connected with the relevant owner” substitute “ or was an individual connected with the relevant owner ”

elements.requirement: In Step Two of paragraph 20(1) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, if there is no relevant owner who has a corresponding partner, the sum of the lower proportions is nil.

elements.requirement: For the purpose of paragraph (b) of Step 2 in paragraph 20 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, a company is treated as an individual connected with the relevant owner in so far as it holds property as trustee and is connected with the relevant owner solely by reason of section 839(3) of the Taxes Act 1988.

elements.requirement: Paragraph 27A of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 applies where, in calculating the sum of the lower proportions for a transaction under paragraph 12, a connected company would have been a corresponding partner of an original owner but for Step Two including connected persons only if they are individuals, and the connected company and original owner are members of the same group.
elements.quote: This paragraph applies where in calculating the sum of the lower proportions in relation to a transaction (in accordance with paragraph 12)— aa company (“the connected company”) would have been a corresponding partner of a relevant owner (“the original owner”) but for the fact that paragraph (b) of Step Two includes connected persons only if they are individuals, andbthe connected company and the original owner are members of the same group.

elements.requirement: Where paragraph 27A applies, the stamp duty land tax charge for the transaction must be reduced to the amount that would have been payable if the connected company had been a corresponding partner of the original owner for the purpose of calculating the sum of the lower proportions.
elements.quote: The charge in respect of the transaction shall be reduced to the amount that would have been payable had the connected company been a corresponding partner of the original owner for the purposes of calculating the sum of the lower proportions.

elements.requirement: Part 1 of Schedule 7 applies to group relief under paragraph 27A(2) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 as it applies under paragraph 1(1) of Schedule 7, subject to omitting paragraph 2(2)(a), substituting 'a partner who was, at the effective date of the transaction, a partner and a member of the same group as the transferor (“the relevant partner”)' for 'the purchaser' in paragraph 3(1)(a), and making the other modifications specified in paragraph 27(3) to (6).
elements.quote: The provisions of Part 1 of Schedule 7 apply to group relief under sub-paragraph (2) above as to group relief under paragraph 1(1) of Schedule 7, but— awith the omission of paragraph 2(2)(a),bwith the substitution for “the purchaser” in paragraph 3(1)(a) of “a partner who was, at the effective date of the transaction, a partner and a member of the same group as the transferor (“the relevant partner”)”, andcwith the other modifications specified in paragraph 27(3) to (6) above.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of Part 3 of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003, when a person acquires or increases a partnership share, a transfer of an interest in the partnership occurs to that partner and from the other partners.
elements.quote: For the purposes of this Part of this Schedule, where a person acquires or increases a partnership share there is a transfer of an interest in the partnership (to that partner and from the other partners).

elements.requirement: As applied by paragraph 39(1) of Schedule 15 to the Finance Act 2003 for the purposes of paragraph 12 or 20, the connected persons section applies with the omission of subsection (3)(c) regarding a trustee connected with a settlement.
elements.quote: As applied by sub-paragraph (1) for the purposes of paragraph 12 or 20, that section has effect with the omission of subsection (3)(c) (trustee connected with settlement).

elements.requirement: In paragraphs 3(1) and 4 of Schedule 16 to the Finance Act 2003, the phrase 'or an interest in a partnership' is inserted after 'a chargeable interest'.
elements.quote: in paragraph 3(1) (bare trust), after “a chargeable interest” insert “ or an interest in a partnership ”, and (b) in paragraph 4 (trustees of settlement), after “a chargeable interest” insert “ or an interest in a partnership ”
